a2a2a_message.action_requested: Dev Dashboard Architecture Redesign — From Vanilla JS (3 files) to Component Structure

context.goal:
apps/dev-dashboard/ currently has only 3 vanilla JS files (src/index.html, src/styles.css, src/app.js) plus server.mjs and package.json. The refactor plan targets 50+ files but the architecture must be designed FIRST before code generation.

This task is ARCHITECTURE DESIGN ONLY — produce:
1. A detailed component tree (React/TSX or keep vanilla? Recommend approach)
2. Page layout wireframe (text-based)
3. State management strategy (how dashboard reads from _A2A_QUEUE, services health endpoints)
4. API contract: which backend endpoints does the dashboard consume?
5. File structure blueprint (exact file paths + responsibilities)
6. Build tooling decision (Vite vs webpack vs none)

Design the architecture for these pages:
  - ReleaseGates (approval workflow visualization)
  - KillSwitches (emergency stop controls)
  - AgentQueue (live _A2A_QUEUE/inbox + assigned + done visualization)
  - ApprovalQueue (pending human-approval packets)
  - ServiceHealth (poll /health + /ready from all services)
  - Logs (real-time log tailing)
